The code statements that fix the bug are:
```java
private File baseDir = new File(System.getProperty("user.dir") + "/target/mini-tests/" + this.getClass().getName());
```
```java
testDir = new File(baseDir, testName.getMethodName());
```
```java
MiniAccumuloCluster accumulo = new MiniAccumuloCluster(testDir, "superSecret");
```
Reason:
By switching to a structured directory within the `target` folder specific to each test case, the tests are better isolated from one another. This reduces the likelihood of conflicts and ensures that each test has its own dedicated resources, mitigating issues caused by shared temporary files.
